description: The intent a mapped action produces when its control is pressed (began) or released (ended). The rule is stateless (HK-033): the one-hold-at-a-time bookkeeping belongs to the caller. A hold action (pushToTalk, pushToTalkDraft) gives beginVoiceCapture in its mode (send, draft) on the press and endVoiceCapture on the release. Every other action fires on the press only and gives null on the release; none gives null for both. Input is {action: <action descriptor>, phase}; expected is an intent descriptor ({"intent": <Swift case name>} plus "mode" for beginVoiceCapture and "prompt" for sendPrompt) or null.
function: IntentMapper.intent(for:phase:) — input {action, phase}, expected an intent descriptor or null
verifiedBy: DESIGN.md v2.7 A and C; Tests/PowerUpTests/MappingFixtureTests.swift testIntentForActionTable runs IntentMapper.intent(for:phase:).
